sections.Profile:
Bon Voyage , released by Bally in November 1974, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Jim Patla with artwork by Dave Christensen. The game revolves around an aviation and travel theme.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Aviation, Single Player, Travel, Transportation, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Jim Patla
- Art: Dave Christensen
sections.Editions: - Bon Voyage: 1,585 made, released 1974-11-01, model number 1016
